description: Hold a place in the line at the Sprawl Gate, then carry the ticket down to the Under Entrance for someone who matters more than you. 15₵.
name: Hold a Place

objectives.desc: Hold the place at the Sprawl Gate
emotes: {who} plants both feet at the Sprawl Gate and glares at anyone who even thinks about cutting the line.
{who} leans against the gate, arms crossed, holding the spot like it's sacred ground.
{who} shuffles forward an inch and calls it progress.

objectives.desc: Carry the ticket to the Under Entrance
emotes: {who} hustles the ticket over to the Under Entrance, muttering the number over and over so it doesn't slip their mind.
{who} jogs the ticket toward the Under Entrance, checking it hasn't smudged.
{who} waves the ticket like it's a passport to somewhere important.
